handoff.salientSummary: Fixed all four items: waitlist routes answer with and without a trailing slash, @repo/reservations waitlist/notify-me schemas now match real route payloads (tenant-api and App import them), the waitlist seat endpoint handles occupied tables (409 with occupant; swap/move/overbook resolve atomically and are audited), and the public hold accepts areaPref which Sites now sends. Full tenant-api suite (2480), reservations (74), Sites reservations (88) and App waitlist/reservation tests (202) pass.
handoff.whatWasImplemented: (1) Operator waitlist router registers every route in both slash forms (`both()` helper; router mounted at /book/waitlist and /book/waitlist/); public waitlist and notify-me routes use `bothForms()` with matching method-not-allowed guards. (2) Rewrote packages/reservations/src/schemas/waitlist.ts and public.ts (real 7 statuses, operator add/update/notify/status/seat/reorder/list/quote requests, entry/listing/quote/seat/seat-conflict responses, public join/status, notify-me request/response/cancel) and switched tenant-api routes and App waitlist-api/fixtures to import them. (3) createWalkIn gained an onOccupied hook (and a reservation.overbook audit row); new services/rsv-waitlist-seat-resolution.ts: no resolution -> 409 table_occupied with occupant, occupants, resolutions; swap (unseat/move occupant via assignReservationTables), move (occupant to moveToTableIds or best free table; no_move_target / locked_table_conflict errors), overbook (walk-in overbook, default reason); writes waitlist.seat_resolution audit; all in the outer withReservationWrite transaction under the org lock; guest name only for tokens with guest-read grant. seatWaitlistEntry/route accept resolution and moveToTableIds. (4) holdSchema accepts areaPref; createHold restricts the engine search to that area (ignored if not selectable) via searchPublicDay(areaId); Sites api.createHold input and flow.chooseSlot send areaPref: slot.areaId.
handoff.whatWasLeftUndone: The App seat dialog / floor drop UI still only uses overbook; it does not yet present the swap/move choice (backend contract and App API client types with resolution/moveToTableIds are in place). App waitlist-errors.ts does not yet map the new error codes (no_move_target, swap_target_seated, locked_table_conflict).
